description: Uva Province - Appointed Hon. Rathnayake Mudiyanselage Kumarasiri Rathnayake as Acting Minister of Sports & Youth Affairs, etc., w.e.f. 15.01.2016 and of Agriculture, Irrigation, etc., w.e.f. 20.01.2016
